The '''612th Attack Battalion''' was a unit apart of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ganch]]. They were assigned to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] and worked closely with Ropal's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Tyzen Xebec]]. After Bolla's death, they were assigned to [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Keelyvine Reus]], Tyzen's new Jedi Master.<ref name="aoi" />
